title: Weekly topotecan
context_label: Ovarian, fallopian tube or primary peritoneal cancer
schedule_label: Infusions on days 1, 8 and 15, followed by a week off.
schedule_summary: Topotecan is given over 30 minutes on three weekly visits in a 28-day cycle. Day 22 is a rest day. Blood results determine whether each dose can go ahead.
purpose: Slow the cancer and help with symptoms after earlier treatment.
administration_text: Topotecan is given over 30 minutes on three weekly visits in a 28-day cycle. Day 22 is a rest day. Blood results determine whether each dose can go ahead.
monitoring_summary: Neutrophils, platelets and haemoglobin decide whether the infusion proceeds.
review_status: Feasibility build. Clinical, pharmacy and patient review pending.

agents.name: Topotecan
agents.explanation: It prevents dividing cells from repairing DNA breaks. It also affects bone marrow.
agents.mechanism: It prevents dividing cells from repairing DNA breaks. It also affects bone marrow.
agents.watch: Call urgently for fever, unexpected bleeding or new shortness of breath.

common_effects.title: How you feel between visits
common_effects.text: Tiredness, nausea or appetite changes can make everyday activities harder. Ask your team for help if symptoms interfere with eating or drinking.

serious_effects.title: Low counts · Topotecan
serious_effects.text: Fever, bruising or breathlessness can signal low blood counts.

serious_effects.title: Lung inflammation · Topotecan
serious_effects.text: Call urgently for a new cough or difficulty breathing.

questions.q: What happens at my next visit?
questions.a: Infusions on days 1, 8 and 15, followed by a week off.

questions.q: Which symptoms should I phone about?
questions.a: Call your oncology unit urgently for fever, shivering or sudden illness. A new cough, shortness of breath or unexpected bleeding also needs urgent assessment.

questions.q: What should I plan before starting?
questions.a: Ask which blood results are needed before the first infusion.

questions.q: Do I come for topotecan in the fourth week?
questions.a: Treatment visits are days 1, 8 and 15. Day 22 is a planned break. If a dose is held, ask your team for the next confirmed blood test and treatment dates.

consent_support: Discuss the expected benefit, side effects, fertility, alternatives and symptom-directed care with the treating clinician. You may ask for more time or change your decision.

evidence.title: TOWER
evidence.interpretation: Weekly dosing caused less severe blood toxicity than the five-day schedule in the randomised phase II study.
evidence.limitations: The study enrolled platinum-resistant disease. Choice of schedule also depends on prior treatment and the activity required.
